aula.text: **Ações:** turn on / turn off (ligar / desligar), plug in (conectar na tomada), restart (reiniciar), reset (restaurar).

"I entered in my account, but the app fell." O certo é **I logged in to my account, but the app crashed.**

lessons.title: Quantificadores
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: Quantificadores: much, many, a lot of, a few, few, a little, little, too much, too many, enough.

head: Ideia
Contável (apps, photos)
Incontável (data, money, time)
rows: a lot of / lots of / plenty of
a lot of / lots of / plenty of

aula.text: *I have a few apps* quer dizer "tenho alguns" (positivo). *I have few apps* quer dizer "tenho pouquíssimos" (negativo).
**Posição de enough:** antes do substantivo (*enough money*) e depois do adjetivo (*big enough*).

items: "I have many work." *Work* é incontável. O certo é **I have a lot of work.**
"There are much people." O certo é **many people** ou **a lot of people.**
"The screen isn't enough big." O certo é **big enough.**

exercises.prompt: How ___ (many / much) data do you use every month?
I have ___ (a few / a little) photos on my phone. Not many.
I have too much apps on my phone.
acc: I have too many apps on my phone
I've too many apps on my phone

exercises.prompt: There are much people at the shop.
acc: There are many people at the shop
There are a lot of people at the shop
The screen is not big enough

lessons.title: Inglês prático, suporte técnico
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Pedir suporte técnico.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: My phone won't turn on. / The app keeps crashing. / I can't log in. / The screen is frozen.
It started yesterday. / It happens every time I... / I've already tried restarting it.
Could you walk me through it? / Can you help me fix this?
Go to Settings. / Tap on... / Press and hold...
Did that work? / It's working now. Thanks!

items: "It don't work." O certo é **It doesn't work.**
"The app doesn't open since yesterday." O certo é **The app hasn't opened since yesterday.**

exercises.prompt: The app doesn't open since yesterday.
acc: The app hasn't opened since yesterday
The app has not opened since yesterday
